label: D1 fixation step late in the episode (trial >= ~85), sparse
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2) and only late in the episode: no activity before trial 60, 81% of mass in trials 90-99, rate climbing steeply toward the end. It co-occurs with low model value (81% of mass in the lowest value bin, which also reflects late-episode position). (phase==D1)&(ep_trial>=85) gets ~93% of mass on dev, but precision is only ~5%: within late D1 steps it fires sparsely. Rate is higher after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward 0: 2.2x lift, 82% of mass) and when the D1 policy logit leans toward a1 (choice>0), and on trials where the agent then switches (stay 0: 4.7x). Adding prev_reward==0 & choice>0 raises F1 to only ~0.31 and drops mass recall to 0.61, so I recorded the simple predicate. All variables are observed (episode time, phase); none are future. Magnitude was not checked beyond the quartile coverage, which is flat over activation quartiles. The feature probably encodes an end-of-episode or time signal in its magnitude, gated by D1 and by an unrewarded or low-value context.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (D1: a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u, a2 S2 r) and trial before (D1: a1 S1 u, a2 S1 u, a1 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D1 & ep_dec=9, phase=D1 & ep_dec=8, phase=D1 & ep_dec=7.
